sloka: ताम् वेपमानाम् उपलक्ष्य सीताम्स रावणो मृत्यु सम प्रभावः ।कुलम् बलम् नाम च कर्म च आत्मनःसमाचचक्षे भय कारण अर्थम् ॥३-४७-५०॥
transliteration: tām vepamānām upalakṣya sītāmsa rāvaṇo mṛtyu sama prabhāvaḥ ।kulam balam nāma ca karma ca ātmanaḥsamācacakṣe bhaya kāraṇa artham ॥3-47-50॥

translations.english: Beholding Sita who was trembling, Ravana, powerful like death, started telling about himself, his clan, his strength and his deeds to instil more fear in her. इत्तयार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे सप्तचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyseventh sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
